LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

MerchantTradeDef.description: One trade of a merchant: what it gives for a price in coins, or for the items it wants.

max_uses.description: How often it can be bought before the merchant restocks at its workstation (vanilla's max_uses).
max_uses.title: Max Uses

price.description: What it costs, in the smallest coin (copper): 250 is 2 Silver Coins and 50 Copper Coins. Paid in the largest coins, which must be at most two coin types and at most 99 of each. Either price or wants.
price.title: Price

wants.description: Instead of a price: the one or two items it takes, for a trade that is not paid in coins (a merchant that buys). Either price or wants.
wants.title: Wants

MerchantTradeDef.title: MerchantTradeDef

TradeStackDef.description: An item and how many of it: what a trade gives, or one of the costs it wants.

count.description: How many, at most one stack of the item.
count.title: Count

item.description: The item, e.g. minecraft:netherrack. Validated against the ID universe.
item.title: Item

TradeStackDef.title: TradeStackDef

description: A villager profession of ours with a workstation and a fixed list of trades at fixed prices.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

name.description: The profession's name, shown over the trades: Ancient Builder.

trades.description: Its trades, in the order the trade screen lists them. All are offered at once: no levels.
trades.title: Trades

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

work_sound.description: The sound of the villager working at its workstation, a sound event; none by default.
work_sound.title: Work Sound

workstation.description: The block of ours (content/blocks/) that is its job site: a jobless villager near one takes the profession, as with vanilla's workstations.
workstation.title: Workstation
